report.text:
Findings: The chest X-ray shows an enlarged heart, with evidence of scarring (fibrosis) and an infiltrate. Additionally, there is pleural thickening, a nodule, and collapsed lung tissue, as well as some emphysema.

Impression: The chest X-ray demonstrates a complex pattern of lung and pleural abnormalities.
